title: Anticucho Boliviano
description: Anticucho Boliviano is a dish from Bolivia featuring beef heart, aji panca paste, garlic, white vinegar. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 70 minutes.
Thread the already marinated pieces on skewers, leaving small gaps for even cooking.
Grill the marinated portions from the preceding steps, turning to cook evenly and checking the safe internal temperature.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
